If the raw value for a string-valued property is not a string,
warn and discard the value.

-- test.glx --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties:
            # name is a string-valued property.
            name: 3
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            name: Pete Ham

-- want-errors --
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.name: value discarded: expected string, got int
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.name: entry discarded: has neither value nor fields
persons\[person-with-error\].Properties.name: property discarded: no entries

-- want-catalog.yaml --
persons:
    person-with-error:
        properties: {}
    person-well-formed:
        properties:
            name:
                definition:
                    label: Name
                    value_type: string
                entries:
                -   value: StringValue{"Pete Ham"}
